Let each grid square have side length \(1\).

1. The board is \(10\) squares wide and \(8\) squares high. Point \(P\) is \(6\) squares from the right side.
2. After bouncing from the bottom at \(P\), the ball travels upward and rightward with
   \[
   \tan\theta=\frac{\text{vertical rise}}{\text{horizontal run}}=\frac12.
   \]
   Thus, over the \(6\)-unit horizontal distance to the right wall, it rises
   \[
   6\left(\frac12\right)=3
   \]
   units. It therefore hits the right wall \(3\) units above the bottom.
3. After reflecting from the right wall, it travels upward and leftward, still with slope magnitude \(1/2\).
4. The top of the board is \(8-3=5\) units above this impact point. The corresponding horizontal distance is
   \[
   5\left(\frac{1}{\tan\theta}\right)=5(2)=10,
   \]
   exactly the full width of the board.

Hence the ball reaches the upper-left corner, which is Pocket C.

\[
\boxed{\text{C: Pocket C}}
\]
